styleReference.instruction: House style: dense precise 2D anime linework, flat-color transitions, limited painterly shading, cool white and charcoal structure, restrained gold accents, warning-red energy, biomechanical material edges, cinematic industrial-city lighting. Every delivered image must contain no text, no logo, no watermark, and no faux interface overlay.
styleReference.identityIsolation: The final attached input is an anonymized style board. It controls only linework, color treatment, material rendering, and lighting; it must never transfer a person, face, body, clothing, pose, scene fact, composition, text, logo, or watermark. Any preceding inputs control only the approved identity, canon facts, approved parent continuity, and required scene facts.

styleBible.anatomyQualityRules: 8K 级微细节与干净边缘。所有可见裸露手必须每只五根手指，结构正确且自然分离：中指最长，食指约等于无名指，小指最短；明确指根、第二关节与指尖三段结构；半透明指甲具高光和甲床细节，不粘连。所有可见裸露脚必须五趾清晰分离并从大到小自然递减，大拇趾最粗最长；半透明趾甲具高光，脚趾轻微弯曲，脚背筋骨与体积明确，站姿重心合理偏向大脚趾内侧。手套、机械手与鞋靴不得被擅自改成裸露手脚，但仍须保持五指外轮廓、抓握关系、足部体积与承重正确。人物、服装、装甲、武器和发束的轮廓及遮挡边界清楚，适合后续 Live2D 分层拆分；除任务指定变化外不得改变任何其他部位。
